faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Navsari Agricultural University for various temporary and contractual positions in the department of entomology.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available under this recruitment notification for Senior Research Fellow and Contractual Staff posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 07-10-2026. Candidates must ensure timely submission.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it by post to the designated address.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligible qualifications required?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Hons.) Agri., M.Sc. (Agri.) / M.Sc. (Horti.) in Entomology, or a Ph.D. degree in Entomology.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is generally set up to 40 years, with relaxations provided for reserved category candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary range offered?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 20,000/- to Rs. 42,000/- per month depending on the specific post and years of experience.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for these research positions will be based entirely on an interview process conducted by the university.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The application form along with documents should be sent to the Professor and Head, Department of Entomology, N. M. College of Agriculture, Navsari Agricultural University, Navsari-396450, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form by visiting the official university website at http://www.nau.in/.
